title: Health Minister JP Nadda Undergoes Coronary Angiography at AIIMS Delhi After Uneasiness
excerpt: Nadda was admitted to AIIMS New Delhi on August 13 evening for cardiac evaluation. He is stable and under observation, but the hospital has not disclosed the angiography results.
body:
• Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda was admitted to AIIMS New Delhi on the evening of August 13 after experiencing uneasiness
  • He underwent a coronary angiography as part of a cardiac evaluation and is currently stable under observation in the Cardiology Department
  • AIIMS has not disclosed the angiography findings or a specific diagnosis; no timeline for discharge has been indicated

Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda was hospitalised at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) in New Delhi on the evening of August 13 after complaining of uneasiness, the hospital confirmed on Thursday.

Nadda underwent a coronary angiography — a diagnostic procedure to examine the blood vessels supplying the heart — as part of his medical evaluation. According to an official AIIMS statement signed by Dr (Prof.) Rima Dada, the minister is "currently stable and admitted for observation in the Dept of Cardiology."

Hospital Statement and What Remains Unclear

The AIIMS statement was notably brief. While confirming the angiography was performed, the hospital did not disclose the results of the procedure or provide a specific diagnosis for Nadda's condition. The nature of the "uneasiness" that prompted the evaluation also remains undisclosed.

"J.P. Nadda, Hon'ble Minister of Health and Family Welfare was evaluated for uneasiness with tests including a coronary angiography on the evening of 13th August 2026. He is currently stable and admitted for observation in the Dept of Cardiology."

— AIIMS New Delhi official statement

Coronary angiography is a standard diagnostic cardiac procedure in which doctors inject a contrast dye into the coronary arteries through a catheter, typically inserted via an artery in the wrist or groin. X-ray imaging then reveals whether arteries are narrowed or blocked, helping clinicians determine if further intervention such as angioplasty, stenting, or medication adjustments may be required.

Nadda's Role and Recent Activity

Nadda, 65, holds the dual portfolios of Health and Family Welfare and Chemicals and Fertilisers in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's cabinet. He had been actively engaged in official duties in the weeks leading up to his hospitalisation, chairing meetings, reviewing healthcare programmes, and participating in Independence Day preparations.

As the country's Health Minister, Nadda's hospitalisation carries particular significance. He has been a key figure in the government's healthcare expansion, overseeing the growth of the AIIMS network from 6 to 22 institutions and driving initiatives including Ayushman Bharat and Jan Aushadhi Kendras.

Earlier this month, Nadda visited AIIMS Rajkot in Gujarat on August 10, where he reviewed the institute's progress in virus detection capabilities and flagged off a Tiranga Yatra ahead of Independence Day celebrations.

What Happens Next

Nadda remains under observation in the Cardiology Department at AIIMS New Delhi. No timeline for discharge has been indicated by the hospital, and further updates on his condition are expected as the medical team completes its assessment. Political leaders across parties have wished him a speedy recovery.
